proposals.evidence: DEDR1628 explicitly gives Kota kukīr- (past kukrc-) to sit down. The original LSI response is kū-kiru, installed as kū kiru: the full sequence closely matches that single lexical verb despite differing written vowel lengths, final u and hyphenation. Retain the source segmentation; do not invent two independent inherited components merely from the hyphen.
